blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) said a minor phreatomagmatic eruption occurred at the main crater of Taal volcano on Thursday evening, and warned of thin ashfall affecting nearby areas. The eruption occurred at 06:06 p.m. and lasted at least five minutes, based on seismic and camera recordings from the […]...
